This is the "champions" tournament from the first two seasons of D&N. Tournament only by appearances. Tournament will take place on April 26 and will be streamed by [https://twitch.tv/amd_glad gLAd] (hope so).

===Media===
* [https://vk.com/video-168103448_456253232 Super final by Cookie]
* [https://vk.com/video-168103448_456253233 All tournament by Cookie]
* [https://youtu.be/qlPusooAKVE?si=ZhwLlzEPWm21RLar All tournament by gLAd]

===Format===
* Double Elimination brackets
* 10 min map with 3 min overtime
* All rounds are {{abbr|BO3|Best of Three}}
* Rnd, Pick, Pick, Toss, Toss, Play
* Default map pool of 5 maps
* Ruleset: smackdown / smackdrive / qcon / thunderdome
* Allowed only russian speak players
* A player who lost with {{abbr|WO|Walk Over}} in WB will automatically lose with WO in LB too.
